title: When I lost my shadow
author: Rashmi Mohapatra/ ରଶ୍ମି ମହାପାତ୍ର
text:
At noon, where light stretches long,
I search for my shadow, elusive in the blaze.
The sun, relentless, denies me shade,
leaving me alone with the ground`s glare.

On asphalt streets, heat ripples,
waves distorting the space I should occupy.
Beneath the peepal`s whispering leaves,
even there, no dark twin follows.

In mirrors, I seek a trace,
but they mock me with hollow reflections.
The grass, seared yellow, offers no cover,
no hint of the familiar silhouette.

I wander, tracing steps in circles,
as if the sun itself consumes my presence.
Ghosts of yesterday linger in memory,
a fleeting glimpse of what once was.

If I am shadowless, who am I?
The earth turns, pulling light with it,
while I remain, a sunlit wanderer,
searching for the lost part of my being.

Evening will come, soft and forgiving,
and maybe then, in twilight`s embrace,
I`ll find my shadow again,
and know myself whole once more.
